prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production raster sprite atlas for ASTRA, a precision star-energy fighter aircraft in a top-down vertical scrolling shoot-em-up game. Transparent alpha background. Wide 3:1 canvas with exactly THREE equal square cells in one horizontal row, no borders or labels. SAME aircraft in every cell: left cell neutral level flight, middle cell slight banking left, right cell slight banking right. All noses point straight UP, perfectly centered at the same local center, same visible height and scale, complete silhouette with generous clear margins in each cell and no overlap. Orthographic overhead view, no perspective facing camera. Elegant long spear-shaped nose, compact cockpit, swept angular wings, silver-white titanium armor, deep gunmetal recesses, restrained copper-orange star-energy channels, warm amber cockpit, twin compact rear engine sockets at bottom near center. A distinct detailed hand-painted sci-fi game sprite with convincing metallic shading and crisp readable dark edges, matching premium painted raster aircraft game art. Real aircraft surface detail, panel seams and layered armor, readable when small. No orbit rings, no background, no ground shadow, no exhaust trails extending beyond ship, no text, no watermark, no diagrams, no SVG/vector flat primitive look. The three poses must preserve identical ship design, colors, nose and engine placement and fit wholly within their three evenly spaced cells.
layout: Three equal horizontal raster cells; original generated RGBA pixels preserved. Bounds use alpha >16; no vector replacement or gameplay hitbox changes.
